title: JS Constructor, INC
description:
JS Contractor Inc. is a Philippine recruitment and manpower agency that specializes in recruiting, screening, processing, and deploying Filipino workers for overseas employment. Established in 1977, the company connects qualified applicants with international employers across industries such as manufacturing, engineering, technical services, and skilled labor. Through its website, applicants can explore job opportunities, submit applications, and access information about overseas employment.

We have all your critical files, encrypted with the strongest encryption, along with over 150,000 resumes and applicants' vaccination records. This includes 3.5 GB of your databases containing sensitive applicant information. PI and SPI data. A total of millions.

Contact us, or we will publish your applicants' data and critical files. Other threat actors will use it for identity theft and other crimes. We will ensure your company's reputation will be in hell. Your business integrity will be compromised. Loss of stakeholders will follow. And the company's credibility will be damaged. This will be your downfall.
